processing.barriers: Original city, water, forest, explicit natural cover, airport, original major roads with 12 m side clearance, other known source land-use classes. No new anchors.

limitations: Not a geographic urban/land-use mask or real building footprint. Source datasets are unchanged.
Only schematic ordinary model footprints may extend up to 80 m from their original developed source region, while anchors, roads, water, terrain and landmarks retain geographic positions.
Original-source overlap and the bounded display envelope must be audited separately; do not claim zero original-source overhang.
